evidence.notes: Single-record external-id upsert creates a local Account through the DML engine and returns an UpsertResult.
Single-record external-id upsert accepts AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and updates the existing Account.
List external-id upsert creates ordered UpsertResult rows for Account values carried as Object.
List external-id upsert accepts AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and updates existing Account rows.
List external-id upsert with allOrNone=false returns per-row success and failure results.
List external-id upsert with allOrNone=false and AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE returns ordered UpsertResult rows.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseUpsertSObjectFieldEvidenceTest { @isTest static void upsertsExternalIdFieldRows() { Account singleCreate = new Account(Name = 'Single Create', Other_Key__c = 'single-key'); Object singleCreateObject = singleCreate; Database.UpsertResult created = Database.upsert(singleCreateObject, Account.Other_Key__c); System.assert(created.isSuccess()); System.assert(created.isCreated()); System.assertNotEquals(null, created.getId()); Account singleUpdate = new Account(Name = 'Single Update', Other_Key__c = 'SINGLE-KEY'); Object singleUpdateObject = singleUpdate; Database.UpsertResult updated = Database.upsert(singleUpdateObject, Account.Other_Key__c, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(created.getId(), updated.getId()); Database.UpsertResult updatedBoth = Database.upsert((Object) new Account(Name = 'Single Both', Other_Key__c = 'SINGLE-KEY'), Account.Other_Key__c, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updatedBoth.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updatedBoth.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(created.getId(), updatedBoth.getId()); List<Object> createRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Create One', Other_Key__c = 'list-one'), new Account(Name = 'List Create Two', Other_Key__c = 'list-two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> createResults = Database.upsert(createRows, Account.Other_Key__c); System.assertEquals(2, createResults.size()); System.assert(createResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(createResults[0].isCreated()); System.assert(createResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(createResults[1].isCreated()); List<Object> updateRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Update One', Other_Key__c = 'LIST-ONE'), new Account(Name = 'List Update Two', Other_Key__c = 'LIST-TWO')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> updateResults = Database.upsert(updateRows, Account.Other_Key__c, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, updateResults.size()); System.assert(updateResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!updateResults[0].isCreated()); System.assertEquals(createResults[0].getId(), updateResults[0].getId()); System.assert(updateResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(!updateResults[1].isCreated()); System.assertEquals(createResults[1].getId(), updateResults[1].getId()); List<Object> mixedRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Mixed One', Other_Key__c = 'mixed-one'), new Account(Other_Key__c = 'mixed-two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> mixedResults = Database.upsert(mixedRows, Account.Other_Key__c, false); System.assertEquals(2, mixedResults.size()); System.assert(mixedResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!mixedResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', mixedResults[1].getErrors()[0].getStatusCode()); List<Object> bothRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Both One', Other_Key__c = 'both-one'), new Account(Name = 'List Both Two', Other_Key__c = 'both-two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> bothResults = Database.upsert(bothRows, Account.Other_Key__c, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, bothResults.size()); System.assert(bothResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(bothResults[0].isCreated()); System.assert(bothResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(bothResults[1].isCreated()); System.assertEquals(6, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Other_Key__c IN ('single-key', 'list-one', 'list-two', 'mixed-one', 'both-one', 'both-two')]); } }
